DAVID App specializes in ovulation test and prediction, which is crucial for women in their trying to conceive journey, through which improve their chance of pregnancy and quality of feus. 
Users can easily upload the test result of ovulation test kit to the App after addition of urine sample into the kit, after that the intelligent App will quickly identify the result, then ovulation calculator will help you to predict ovulation.
Among the App, modules such as menstrual cycle calculation, ovulation detection, pregnancy related knowledge, personal data, message, test records, help, system setting, etc. are included.
